name: region
description: Broad natural and cultivated geographic regions

fields.Name: Temperate Forest
fields.Description: mixed woodland crossed by game trails, logging roads, and clear streams.

fields.Name: Dry Scrubland
fields.Description: thorny brush, red earth, seasonal rivers, and widely separated wells.

fields.Name: Frozen Tundra
fields.Description: permafrost, low vegetation, migrating animals, and brief violent summers.

fields.Name: Salt Desert
fields.Description: blinding flats, buried ruins, mineral caravans, and almost no fresh water.

fields.Name: Badlands
fields.Description: eroded canyons, exposed fossils, little water, and excellent hiding places.

fields.Name: Wine Hills
fields.Description: cultivated slopes, wealthy estates, old cellars, and intense local rivalries.

fields.Name: Flooded Forest
fields.Description: half-submerged trees navigated by canoe during a long wet season.

fields.Name: Crystal Expanse
fields.Description: natural glass formations distort light, sound, direction, and magic.

fields.Name: Dead Magic Basin
fields.Description: a fertile-looking depression where supernatural effects abruptly fail.

fields.Name: Storm Belt
fields.Description: a coastal region battered by near-constant wind, rain, and electrical activity.

fields.Name: Mushroom Wilds
fields.Description: damp country dominated by giant fungi, spores, and underground settlements.

fields.Name: Deep Forest
fields.Description: An ancient forest of fading paths, isolated clearings, and territories claimed by wildlife.

fields.Name: Stifling Jungle
fields.Description: Dense vegetation, violent rain, and ruins slowly swallowed by roots.

fields.Name: Arid Desert
fields.Description: Dunes and rocky plateaus where water sources determine routes and conflicts.

fields.Name: Open Grassland
fields.Description: Wide windswept grasslands suited to herds, travelers, and ambushes visible from afar.

fields.Name: Lake District
fields.Description: Lakes, islets, and fishing villages linked by boats and flood-prone paths.

fields.Name: Cliff Coast
fields.Description: A steep coast cut by coves, sea caves, and hazardous passages.

fields.Name: River Valley
fields.Description: A fertile region organized around a river, fortified bridges, and rival ports.

fields.Name: Mountain Range
fields.Description: Hard-to-reach peaks sheltering mines, monasteries, and strategic passes.

fields.Name: Pack Ice
fields.Description: An unstable frozen sea where routes change with fractures and animal migrations.

fields.Name: Monumental Glacier
fields.Description: A mass of ice crossed by crevasses, blue caves, and trapped remains.

fields.Name: Archipelago
fields.Description: Islands separated by reefs, unpredictable currents, and disputed sea lanes.

fields.Name: Floating Archipelago
fields.Description: Suspended lands linked by bridges and airships, with waterfalls falling into the void.

fields.Name: Volcanic Highlands
fields.Description: Ash slopes, hot springs, and valuable seams beneath an active volcano.

fields.Name: Misty Marsh
fields.Description: Shallow waters, peat bogs, and islands whose paths change with the seasons.

fields.Name: Agricultural Hills
fields.Description: Terraced crops, scattered farms, and guarded market roads.

fields.Name: Abandoned Battlefield
fields.Description: A territory marked by trenches, wreckage, and supernatural traces of an old war.

fields.Name: Celestial Region
fields.Description: Air currents, solid clouds, and weather phenomena form a traversable but unstable territory.
